howto.name: Upload a BMP
howto.text: Drop a Windows bitmap file (any depth: 1-bit, 8-bit, 24-bit, or 32-bit).

howto.name: Convert and download
howto.text: Click Convert. The BMP is re-encoded as a compressed lossless PNG, ideal for screenshots and pixel art.

faq.a: PNG is lossless like BMP but uses compression — typically 70–90% smaller files. PNG is also the standard format for web and modern software.
Yes — pixel-perfect identical. PNG uses lossless compression, so no pixel data changes.
Supported. 1-bit, 4-bit, and 8-bit palette BMPs convert to indexed-color PNGs preserving the original palette.
